title: Dealer settings and users
completionMessage: {dealer.firm} profile is shown. The staff user list now shows {staff.count} staff users, including {staff.newUser.firstName} as {staff.newUser.role}. The N11 role assignment for a dealer and its sub-dealers is not defined yet.

dealer-profile.proposedAction: Read the dealer profile and the settings
dealer-profile.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the effects of the shop location save, document upload and profile photo cannot be shown. The other dealer_profile fields are read-only, and their labels are not listed in the spec.

dealer-users-list.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the list columns cannot be taken from the spec. The columns shown are the O52 labels (assumption).

dealer-users-after.proposedAction: Read the staff user list after the submit
dealer-users-after.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the N11 role assignment for a dealer and its connected sub-dealers cannot be shown. It depends on the sub-dealer clarification document, which is not in the repo yet.
dealer-users-after.performedText: read the staff users list, now with {staff.newUser.firstName}
